Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Hosted Band adds join-code sessions with a connected roster and scheduled playback. Includes Concert Director, opt-in party follow, and Shortcut Bars.
Changelog: Hosted Band adds a join-code roster, synchronized cues, and a runnable relay bundled with the installer.
